build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with a ball hovering over a jar on a bottom wall
create_physics_scene: create a physics scene with a static bar, dynamic jar, and dynamic ball using the PHYRE creator library
parametrize_task_positions: parametrize task positions for jar x, jar y, jar scale, and ball y coordinates
set_task_assignment: set the task assignment to make the ball touch the bottom wall using PHYRE spatial relationships
skip_invalid_params: skip template parameters when the jar position falls outside the scene width bounds
